objective1.dial: A new presence has entered the Matrix. Programs that do not belong to the Source, nor to the Merovingian. They call themselves Oligarchs.

objective2.dial: You perceive what you cannot understand. We are above your simulation.

objective3.dial: Analyzing... this code doesn't match standard Machine architecture. It's older. Much older.

objective6.dial: As I feared. Halborn has returned. The Oligarchs will not rest until they control both the Matrix and the real world.

objective7.dial: This intelligence is terrifying. The Oligarchs have physical bodies? We must prepare.
